+}
+
+/**
+ * Verify the integrity of a menu snapshot using SHA-256 hash.
+ *
+ * Re-computes the hash from the stored snapshot data and compares
+ * it with the stored hash to verify data integrity.
+ *
+ * @param snapshotId - The UUID of the snapshot to verify
+ * @returns Promise<SnapshotVerificationResult> - Verification result
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```typescript
+ * const result = await verifySnapshotHash(snapshotId)
+ * if (result.success && result.isValid) {
+ *   console.log('Snapshot integrity verified!')
+ * } else {
+ *   console.error('Snapshot has been tampered with!')
+ * }
+ * ```
+ */
+export async function verifySnapshotHash(
+  snapshotId: string
+): Promise<SnapshotVerificationResult> {
+  if (!snapshotId) {
+    return {
+      success: false,
+      isValid: false,
+      error: 'Snapshot ID gereklidir',
+    }
+  }
+
+  const snapshotResult = await getSnapshotById(snapshotId)
+
+  if (!snapshotResult.success || !snapshotResult.data) {
+    return {
+      success: false,
+      isValid: false,
+      error: snapshotResult.error || 'Snapshot bulunamad\u0131',
+    }
+  }
+
+  const snapshot = snapshotResult.data
+  const storedHash = snapshot.hash
+
+  // Re-compute hash from stored data
+  const computedHash = await generateSHA256Hash(snapshot.snapshot_data)
+
+  return {
+    success: true,
+    isValid: storedHash === computedHash,
+    storedHash,
+    computedHash,
+  }
+}

+/**

+ * Returns paginated list of all snapshots for audit and compliance.

+ * @returns Promise<SnapshotListResult> - Result with snapshot list
+ *
+ * @example

+ */
+export async function getSnapshotHistory(

+): Promise<SnapshotListResult> {

+  const supabase = await createServerSupabaseClient()
+
+  const { data, error, count } = await supabase
+    .from('menu_snapshots')
+    .select('*', { count: 'exact' })
+    .eq('organization_id', organizationId)
+    .order('version', { ascending: false })
+    .range(offset, offset + limit - 1)
+
+  if (error) {
+    return {

+      error: error.message || 'Snapshot ge\u00e7mi\u015fi al\u0131namad\u0131',

+
+  return {

+    totalCount: count ?? undefined,
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Get a specific snapshot version by version number.
+ *
+ * @param organizationId - The UUID of the organization
+ * @param version - The version number to retrieve
+ * @returns Promise<SnapshotOperationResult> - Result with snapshot or error
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```typescript
+ * const result = await getSnapshotByVersion(organizationId, 5)
+ * if (result.success && result.data) {
+ *   console.log(`Retrieved version ${result.data.version}`)
+ * }
+ * ```
+ */
+export async function getSnapshotByVersion(
+  organizationId: string,
+  version: number
+): Promise<SnapshotOperationResult> {
+  if (!organizationId) {
+    return {
+      success: false,
+      error: 'Organizasyon ID gereklidir',
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (version < 1) {
+    return {
+      success: false,
+      error: 'Ge\u00e7ersiz versiyon numaras\u0131',
+    }
+  }
+
+  const supabase = await createServerSupabaseClient()
+
+  const { data, error } = await supabase
+    .from('menu_snapshots')
+    .select('*')
+    .eq('organization_id', organizationId)
+    .eq('version', version)
+    .single()
+
+  if (error) {
+    return {
+      success: false,
+      error: error.message || 'Snapshot bulunamad\u0131',
+    }
+  }
+
+  return {
+    success: true,
+    data: data as MenuSnapshot,
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Compare two snapshot versions to identify changes.
+ *
+ * Useful for showing what changed between menu publishes.
+ *
+ * @param organizationId - The UUID of the organization
+ * @param versionA - First version number
+ * @param versionB - Second version number
+ * @returns Promise with comparison result
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```typescript
+ * const diff = await compareSnapshots(orgId, 1, 2)
+ * if (diff.success) {
+ *   console.log(`Added products: ${diff.addedProducts.length}`)
+ *   console.log(`Removed products: ${diff.removedProducts.length}`)
+ * }
+ * ```
+ */
+export async function compareSnapshots(
+  organizationId: string,
+  versionA: number,
+  versionB: number
+): Promise<{
+  success: boolean
+  addedProducts: string[]
+  removedProducts: string[]
+  addedCategories: string[]
+  removedCategories: string[]
+  error?: string
+}> {
+  const [resultA, resultB] = await Promise.all([
+    getSnapshotByVersion(organizationId, versionA),
+    getSnapshotByVersion(organizationId, versionB),
+  ])
+
+  if (!resultA.success || !resultA.data || !resultB.success || !resultB.data) {
+    return {
+      success: false,
+      addedProducts: [],
+      removedProducts: [],
+      addedCategories: [],
+      removedCategories: [],
+      error: 'Bir veya daha fazla snapshot bulunamad\u0131',
+    }
+  }
+
+  const dataA = resultA.data.snapshot_data as unknown as MenuSnapshotData
+  const dataB = resultB.data.snapshot_data as unknown as MenuSnapshotData
+
+  const productIdsA = new Set(dataA.products.map((p) => p.id))
+  const productIdsB = new Set(dataB.products.map((p) => p.id))
+  const categoryIdsA = new Set(dataA.categories.map((c) => c.id))
+  const categoryIdsB = new Set(dataB.categories.map((c) => c.id))
+
+  return {
+    success: true,
+    addedProducts: [...productIdsB].filter((id) => !productIdsA.has(id)),
+    removedProducts: [...productIdsA].filter((id) => !productIdsB.has(id)),
+    addedCategories: [...categoryIdsB].filter((id) => !categoryIdsA.has(id)),
+    removedCategories: [...categoryIdsA].filter((id) => !categoryIdsB.has(id)),
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Export snapshot data for compliance reporting.
+ *
+ * Formats snapshot data for regulatory export, including
+ * hash verification proof.
+ *
+ * @param snapshotId - The UUID of the snapshot to export
+ * @returns Promise with formatted export data
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```typescript
+ * const exportData = await exportSnapshotForCompliance(snapshotId)
+ * // Convert to JSON/CSV for regulatory submission
+ * ```
+ */
+export async function exportSnapshotForCompliance(snapshotId: string): Promise<{
+  success: boolean
+  data?: {
+    snapshot: MenuSnapshot
+    menuData: MenuSnapshotData
+    verification: {
+      hash: string
+      verified: boolean
+      verified_at: string
+    }
+  }
+  error?: string
+}> {
+  const snapshotResult = await getSnapshotById(snapshotId)
+
+  if (!snapshotResult.success || !snapshotResult.data) {
+    return {
+      success: false,
+      error: snapshotResult.error || 'Snapshot bulunamad\u0131',
+    }
+  }
+
+  const verificationResult = await verifySnapshotHash(snapshotId)
+
+  return {
+    success: true,
+    data: {
+      snapshot: snapshotResult.data,
+      menuData: snapshotResult.data.snapshot_data as unknown as MenuSnapshotData,
+      verification: {
+        hash: snapshotResult.data.hash,
+        verified: verificationResult.isValid,
+        verified_at: new Date().toISOString(),
+      },
+    },
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Get the current snapshot for an organization by slug.
+ *
+ * Useful for public menu pages that identify organizations by slug.
+ *
+ * @param slug - The organization slug
+ * @returns Promise<SnapshotOperationResult> - Result with snapshot or error

+ * @example
+ * ```typescript
+ * const result = await getCurrentMenuSnapshotBySlug('my-restaurant')
+ * if (result.success && result.data) {
+ *   // Render public menu
+ * }
+ * ```
+ */
+export async function getCurrentMenuSnapshotBySlug(
+  slug: string
+): Promise<SnapshotOperationResult> {
+  if (!slug) {
+    return {
+      success: false,
+      error: 'Slug gereklidir',
+    }
+  }
+
+  const supabase = await createServerSupabaseClient()
+
+  // First, find organization by slug
+  const { data: organization, error: orgError } = await supabase
+    .from('organizations')
+    .select('id')
+    .eq('slug', slug)
+    .eq('is_active', true)
+    .single()
+
+  if (orgError || !organization) {
+    return {
+      success: false,
+      error: 'Restoran bulunamad\u0131',
+    }
+  }
+
+  return getCurrentMenuSnapshot(organization.id)
+}

+import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
+import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
+import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
+
+export const createServerSupabaseClient = async () => {
+  const cookieStore = await cookies()
+  return createServerClient(
+    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
+    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
+    {
+      cookies: {
+        getAll() {
+          return cookieStore.getAll()
+        },
+        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
+          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
+            cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
+          )
+        },
+      },
+    }
+  )
+}
+
+/**
+ * Create a static Supabase client for use in static generation contexts
+ * (generateStaticParams, etc.) where cookies are not available.
+ * This client is unauthenticated and only has access to public data.
+ * Returns null if environment variables are not set (during build).
+ */
+export const createStaticSupabaseClient = () => {
+  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
+  const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
+
+  if (!url || !key) {
+    return null
+  }
+
+  return createClient(url, key)
+}

+import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
+import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
+
+/**
+ * Route definitions for access control
+ */
+const PUBLIC_ROUTES = ['/', '/features', '/pricing']
+const AUTH_ROUTES = ['/login', '/register', '/password-recovery', '/reset-password', '/verify-email']
+const ADMIN_ROUTE_PREFIX = '/admin'
+
+/**
+ * Routes that are publicly accessible (no auth required)
+ * Includes: public routes, auth routes, public menu pages, API routes, static assets
+ */
+function isPublicPath(pathname: string): boolean {
+  // Public static routes
+  if (PUBLIC_ROUTES.includes(pathname)) return true
+
+  // Auth routes
+  if (AUTH_ROUTES.includes(pathname)) return true
+
+  // Public menu pages: /menu/[slug]
+  if (pathname.startsWith('/menu/')) return true
+
+  // Restaurant landing pages: /r/[slug]
+  if (pathname.startsWith('/r/')) return true
+
+  // OAuth callback
+  if (pathname.startsWith('/auth/callback')) return true
+
+  // API routes (protected via their own auth)
+  if (pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return true
+
+  // Static assets
+  if (
+    pathname.startsWith('/_next/') ||
+    pathname.startsWith('/static/') ||
+    pathname.includes('.') // Files with extensions (favicon.ico, etc.)
+  ) {
+    return true
+  }
+
+  return false
+}
+
+/**
+ * Check if path requires admin access
+ */
+function isAdminPath(pathname: string): boolean {
+  return pathname.startsWith(ADMIN_ROUTE_PREFIX)
+}
+
+export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
+  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl
+
+  // Allow public paths without authentication
+  if (isPublicPath(pathname)) {
+    return NextResponse.next()
+  }
+
+  // Create Supabase client for middleware
+  let response = NextResponse.next({
+    request: {
+      headers: request.headers,
+    },
+  })
+
+  const supabase = createServerClient(
+    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
+    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
+    {
+      cookies: {
+        getAll() {
+          return request.cookies.getAll()
+        },
+        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
+          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =>
+            request.cookies.set(name, value)
+          )
+          response = NextResponse.next({
+            request: {
+              headers: request.headers,
+            },
+          })
+          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
+            response.cookies.set(name, value, options)
+          )
+        },
+      },
+    }
+  )
+
+  // Check authentication status
+  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
+
+  // If no user, redirect to login for protected routes
+  if (!user || authError) {
+    const loginUrl = new URL('/login', request.url)
+    loginUrl.searchParams.set('redirectTo', pathname)
+    return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl)
+  }
+
+  // Check admin access for admin routes
+  if (isAdminPath(pathname)) {
+    // Query user's super admin status from app_metadata or a dedicated table
+    // Super admin check: user has is_super_admin flag in app_metadata
+    const isSuperAdmin = user.app_metadata?.is_super_admin === true
+
+    if (!isSuperAdmin) {
+      // Non-admin trying to access admin routes - redirect to dashboard
+      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/dashboard', request.url))
+    }
+  }
+
+  return response
+}
+
+export const config = {
+  matcher: [
+    /*
+     * Match all request paths except:
+     * - _next/static (static files)
+     * - _next/image (image optimization files)
+     * - favicon.ico, sitemap.xml, robots.txt (metadata files)
+     */
+    '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|sitemap.xml|robots.txt).*)',
+  ],
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,561 @@
+/**
+ * Unit tests for Select Component
+ *
+ * Tests the reusable Select component with consistent form styling.
+ * Verifies:
+ * 1. Basic rendering with label, helper text, and error states
+ * 2. Accessibility attributes (aria-invalid, aria-describedby)
+ * 3. ID generation (provided vs auto-generated)
+ * 4. Styling variants (normal, error, fullWidth)
+ * 5. Disabled state
+ * 6. Ref forwarding
+ * 7. Custom className application
+ * 8. Children (option) rendering
+ * 9. Value and onChange handling
+ *
+ * @see spec.md - Create Reusable Select Component for Consistent Form Styling
+ */
+
+import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react'
+import { createRef } from 'react'
+import { Select, type SelectProps } from '../select'
+
+describe('Select Component', () => {
+  const defaultOptions = (
+    <>
+      <option value="">Seciniz</option>
+      <option value="option1">Option 1</option>
+      <option value="option2">Option 2</option>
+      <option value="option3">Option 3</option>
+    </>
+  )
+
+  describe('Basic Rendering', () => {
+    it('should render a select element with options', () => {
+      render(<Select>{defaultOptions}</Select>)
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      expect(select).toBeInTheDocument()
+      expect(select).toBeInstanceOf(HTMLSelectElement)
+
+      // Check options are rendered
+      expect(screen.getByRole('option', { name: 'Seciniz' })).toBeInTheDocument()
+      expect(screen.getByRole('option', { name: 'Option 1' })).toBeInTheDocument()
+      expect(screen.getByRole('option', { name: 'Option 2' })).toBeInTheDocument()
+      expect(screen.getByRole('option', { name: 'Option 3' })).toBeInTheDocument()
+    })
+
+    it('should render label when provided', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select label="Test Label">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const label = screen.getByText('Test Label')
+      expect(label).toBeInTheDocument()
+      expect(label.tagName).toBe('LABEL')
+    })
+
+    it('should not render label when not provided', () => {
+      const { container } = render(<Select>{defaultOptions}</Select>)
+
+      const label = container.querySelector('label')
+      expect(label).not.toBeInTheDocument()
+    })
+
+    it('should render helper text when provided and no error', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select helperText="This is helper text">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const helperText = screen.getByText('This is helper text')
+      expect(helperText).toBeInTheDocument()
+      expect(helperText).toHaveClass('text-secondary-500')
+    })
+
+    it('should render chevron icon', () => {
+      const { container } = render(<Select>{defaultOptions}</Select>)
+
+      const chevronIcon = container.querySelector('svg')
+      expect(chevronIcon).toBeInTheDocument()
+      expect(chevronIcon).toHaveAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('Error State', () => {
+    it('should render error message when error prop is provided', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select error="This field is required">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const errorMessage = screen.getByText('This field is required')
+      expect(errorMessage).toBeInTheDocument()
+      expect(errorMessage).toHaveAttribute('role', 'alert')
+      expect(errorMessage).toHaveClass('text-red-600')
+    })
+
+    it('should apply error styles when error is present', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select error="This field is required">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      expect(select).toHaveClass('border-red-500')
+      expect(select).toHaveClass('bg-red-50')
+    })
+
+    it('should set aria-invalid to true when error is present', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select error="This field is required">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      expect(select).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true')
+    })
+
+    it('should hide helper text when error is present', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select
+          helperText="This is helper text"
+          error="This field is required"
+        >
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      expect(screen.queryByText('This is helper text')).not.toBeInTheDocument()
+      expect(screen.getByText('This field is required')).toBeInTheDocument()
+    })
+
+    it('should apply normal styles when no error is present', () => {
+      render(<Select>{defaultOptions}</Select>)
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      expect(select).toHaveClass('border-secondary-300')
+      expect(select).toHaveClass('bg-white')
+    })
+
+    it('should set aria-invalid to false when no error is present', () => {
+      render(<Select>{defaultOptions}</Select>)
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      expect(select).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false')
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('Accessibility', () => {
+    it('should link label to select with htmlFor and id', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select label="Test Label" id="test-select">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const label = screen.getByText('Test Label') as HTMLLabelElement
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+
+      expect(label.htmlFor).toBe('test-select')
+      expect(select).toHaveAttribute('id', 'test-select')
+    })
+
+    it('should generate unique ID when id prop is not provided', () => {
+      const { container } = render(<Select>{defaultOptions}</Select>)
+
+      const select = container.querySelector('select')
+      const id = select?.getAttribute('id')
+
+      expect(id).toBeTruthy()
+      expect(id).toMatch(/^:r\d+:$/) // React useId format
+    })
+
+    it('should set aria-describedby to error id when error is present', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select error="Error message" id="test-select">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      const errorMessage = screen.getByText('Error message')
+
+      expect(select).toHaveAttribute('aria-describedby', 'test-select-error')
+      expect(errorMessage).toHaveAttribute('id', 'test-select-error')
+    })
+
+    it('should set aria-describedby to helper id when helper text is present', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select helperText="Helper text" id="test-select">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      const helperText = screen.getByText('Helper text')
+
+      expect(select).toHaveAttribute('aria-describedby', 'test-select-helper')
+      expect(helperText).toHaveAttribute('id', 'test-select-helper')
+    })
+
+    it('should set aria-describedby to both error and helper when both present', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select helperText="Helper text" error="Error message" id="test-select">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+
+      // Error takes precedence, helper text is hidden
+      expect(select).toHaveAttribute('aria-describedby', 'test-select-error')
+    })
+
+    it('should not set aria-describedby when neither error nor helper text is present', () => {
+      render(<Select>{defaultOptions}</Select>)
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      expect(select).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-describedby')
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('Styling Props', () => {
+    it('should apply fullWidth class by default', () => {
+      const { container } = render(<Select>{defaultOptions}</Select>)
+
+      const wrapper = container.firstChild as HTMLElement
+      expect(wrapper).toHaveClass('w-full')
+    })
+
+    it('should not apply fullWidth class when fullWidth is false', () => {
+      const { container } = render(
+        <Select fullWidth={false}>{defaultOptions}</Select>
+      )
+
+      const wrapper = container.firstChild as HTMLElement
+      expect(wrapper).not.toHaveClass('w-full')
+    })
+
+    it('should apply custom className to select element', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select className="custom-class">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      expect(select).toHaveClass('custom-class')
+    })
+
+    it('should merge custom className with base styles', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select className="custom-class">
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      expect(select).toHaveClass('custom-class')
+      expect(select).toHaveClass('w-full')
+      expect(select).toHaveClass('rounded-lg')
+      expect(select).toHaveClass('border')
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('Disabled State', () => {
+    it('should apply disabled attribute when disabled prop is true', () => {
+      render(
+        <Select disabled>
+          {defaultOptions}
+        </Select>
+      )
+
+      const select = screen.getByRole('combobox')
+      expect(select).toBeDisabled()
+    })
+

+/**
+ * Central type exports for the application
+ *
+ * Import types from this file:

+ */
+
+// Database types
+export type {
+  Json,
+  UserRole,
+  SubscriptionStatus,
+  TableStatus,
+  ServiceRequestStatus,
+  FeatureType,
+  Organization,
+  OrganizationMember,
+  Category,
+  Product,
+  PriceLedgerEntry,
+  CurrentPrice,
+  Feature,
+  Plan,
+  PlanFeature,
+  Subscription,
+  OrganizationFeatureOverride,
+  OrganizationFeature,
+  MenuSnapshot,
+  RestaurantTable,
+  ServiceRequest,
+  AuditLog,
+  Database,
+} from './database'
+
+/**
+ * API response wrapper type
+ */
+export interface ApiResponse<T> {
+  data: T | null
+  error: string | null
+  success: boolean
+}
+
+/**
+ * Pagination parameters
+ */
+export interface PaginationParams {
+  page: number
+  limit: number
+}
+
+/**
+ * Paginated response
+ */
+export interface PaginatedResponse<T> {
+  data: T[]
+  total: number
+  page: number
+  limit: number
+  totalPages: number
+}
+
+/**
+ * Sort configuration
+ */
+export interface SortConfig {
+  field: string
+  direction: 'asc' | 'desc'
+}
+
+/**
+ * Filter configuration
+ */
+export interface FilterConfig {
+  field: string
+  operator: 'eq' | 'neq' | 'gt' | 'gte' | 'lt' | 'lte' | 'like' | 'in'
+  value: string | number | boolean | string[] | number[]
+}
+
+/**
+ * Session user with organization context
+ */
+export interface SessionUser {
+  id: string
+  email: string
+  organizationId: string | null
+  role: import('./database').UserRole | null
+}
+
+/**
+ * Menu builder component types
+ */
+export type MenuComponentType =
+  | 'category'
+  | 'product'
+  | 'divider'
+  | 'header'
+  | 'footer'
+  | 'banner'
+
+/**
+ * Menu builder component configuration
+ */
+export interface MenuComponent {
+  id: string
+  type: MenuComponentType
+  props: Record<string, unknown>
+  children?: MenuComponent[]
+}
+
+/**
+ * Theme configuration for public menu

+export interface MenuTheme {
+  primaryColor: string
+  secondaryColor: string
+  backgroundColor: string
+  textColor: string
+  fontFamily: string
+  borderRadius: number
+  spacing: number
+}

+/**
+ * QR code generation options
+ */
+export interface QRCodeOptions {
+  format: 'svg' | 'png'
+  size?: 1024 | 2048 | 4096

+  includeTableId?: string

+# ozaMenu Architecture
+
+[![Architecture](https://img.shields.io/badge/Architecture-Multi--Tenant-blue)]()
+[![Security](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-RLS-green)]()
+[![Pattern](https://img.shields.io/badge/Pattern-Immutable-orange)]()
+[![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-App%20Router-black)]()
+
+**ozaMenu platformunun teknik mimarisi, tasarim kararlari ve sistem bilesenlerinin detayli dokumantasyonu.**
+
+---
+
+## Icindekiler
+
+- [Mimari Genel Bakis](#mimari-genel-bakis)
+- [Sistem Bileseneleri](#sistem-bileseneleri)
+- [Veritabani Mimarisi](#veritabani-mimarisi)
+- [Guvenlik Mimarisi](#guvenlik-mimarisi)
+- [Multi-Tenant Mimarisi](#multi-tenant-mimarisi)
+- [Veri Akis Patterni](#veri-akis-patterni)
+- [Degismez Fiyat Defteri](#degismez-fiyat-defteri)
+- [Feature Flag Sistemi](#feature-flag-sistemi)
+- [Rollendirme ve Yetkilendirme](#rollendirme-ve-yetkilendirme)
+- [API Mimarisi](#api-mimarisi)
+- [Realtime Mimarisi](#realtime-mimarisi)
+- [QR Kod Sistemi](#qr-kod-sistemi)
+- [Audit ve Compliance](#audit-ve-compliance)
+- [Performans ve Olceklendirme](#performans-ve-olceklendirme)
+- [Deployment Mimarisi](#deployment-mimarisi)
+- [Tasarim Kararlari](#tasarim-kararlari)
+
+---
+
+## Mimari Genel Bakis
+
+ozaMenu, modern SaaS prensiplerine gore tasarlanmis, ozel ihtiyaclara sahip bir platformdur. Platform mimarisi 3 temel pilaye dayanir:
+
+### Temel Prensipler
+
+1. **Degismazlik (Immutability)**: Fiyat kayitlari hicbir zaman degistirilmez veya silinmez
+2. **Multi-Tenancy**: Her isletme tamamen izole edilmis veri ortaminda calisir
+3. **Hukuki Uyumluluk**: Ticaret Bakanligi denetimlerinde kanit niteliginde kayitlar
+
+### Teknoloji Altyapisi
+
+```
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│                    ozaMenu Platform                     │

+## Veritabani Mimarisi
+
+### Entity Relationship Diagram
+
+```
+┌──────────────┐         ┌──────────────────┐
+│organizations │◄────────┤organization_     │
+│              │         │    members       │
+└──────┬───────┘         └──────────────────┘
+       │                          │
+       │                          │
+       ├──────────────────────────┤
+       │                          │
+       ▼                          ▼
+┌──────────────┐         ┌──────────────┐
+│  categories  │         │   products   │
+└──────────────┘         └──────┬───────┘
+                                │
+                                ▼
+                         ┌──────────────┐
+                         │price_ledger  │◄─ IMMUTABLE
+                         └──────────────┘

+
+### Core Tables
+
+#### 1. organizations
+
+Isletmelerin temel bilgilerini tutar.
+
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE organizations (
+  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  name TEXT NOT NULL,
+  slug TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
+  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
+  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true
+);
+```
+
+**Ozellikler:**
+- `slug`: Public menu URL'i icin kullanilir (`/menu/{slug}`)
+- `is_active`: Super Admin tarafindan aktif/pasif yapilabilir
+
+#### 2. organization_members
+
+Kullanicilarin isletmelerdeki uyeliklerini ve rollerini tutar.
+
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE organization_members (
+  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id),
+  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
+  role user_role NOT NULL,
+  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
+  UNIQUE(organization_id, user_id)
+);
+```
+
+**Roller:**
+- `owner`: Isletme sahibi (tum yetkiler)
+- `admin`: Yonetici (kullanici yonetimi haric tum yetkiler)
+- `manager`: Mudur (urun/fiyat yonetimi)
+- `waiter`: Garson (sadece servis talepleri)
+- `viewer`: Izleyici (sadece okuma)
+
+#### 3. products
+
+Urunlerin temel bilgilerini tutar. **NOT**: Fiyat burada tutulmaz!
+
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE products (
+  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id),
+  category_id UUID REFERENCES categories(id),
+  name TEXT NOT NULL,
+  description TEXT,
+  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
+  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
+);
+```
+
+#### 4. price_ledger (IMMUTABLE)
+
+**En kritik tablo!** Fiyat degisiklikleri burada saklanir ve ASLA silinmez/guncellenmez.
+
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE price_ledger (
+  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  product_id UUID REFERENCES products(id),
+  price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
+  effective_from TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
+  change_reason TEXT,
+  changed_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
+  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+-- KRITIK: UPDATE ve DELETE yasaklandi
+CREATE TRIGGER prevent_price_update
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON price_ledger
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_modification();
+
+CREATE TRIGGER prevent_price_delete
+  BEFORE DELETE ON price_ledger
+  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_modification();
+```
+
+**Trigger Fonksiyonu:**
+
+```sql
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prevent_modification()
+RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
+BEGIN
+  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Price ledger is immutable. Use INSERT for new prices.';
+END;
+$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
+```
+
+### View: current_prices
+
+Guncel fiyatlari kolayca okumak icin view:
+
+```sql
+CREATE VIEW current_prices AS
+SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id)
+  product_id,
+  price,
+  effective_from,
+  change_reason
+FROM price_ledger
+ORDER BY product_id, effective_from DESC;
+```

+## Guvenlik Mimarisi
+
+### 1. Row Level Security (RLS)
+
+Her tablo uzerinde RLS aktif edilmistir. Kullanicilar sadece uye olduklari isletmelerin verisine erisebilir.
+
+#### Ornek RLS Policy
+
+```sql
+-- Products tablosu icin SELECT policy
+CREATE POLICY "Users can view own organization products"
+ON products FOR SELECT
+USING (
+  organization_id IN (
+    SELECT organization_id
+    FROM organization_members
+    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
+  )
+);
+
+-- Products tablosu icin INSERT policy
+CREATE POLICY "Managers can insert products"
+ON products FOR INSERT
+WITH CHECK (
+  organization_id IN (
+    SELECT organization_id
+    FROM organization_members
+    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
+      AND role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'manager')
+  )
+);
+```
+
+### 2. Authentication
+
+Supabase Auth ile JWT tabanli kimlik dogrulama:
+
+```
+┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│         Authentication Flow              │
+├──────────────────────────────────────────┤
+│                                          │
+│  1. User Login                           │
+│     ↓                                    │
+│  2. Supabase Auth validates credentials  │
+│     ↓                                    │
+│  3. JWT token issued                     │
+│     ↓                                    │
+│  4. Token stored in httpOnly cookie      │
+│     ↓                                    │
+│  5. Every request includes token         │
+│     ↓                                    │
+│  6. RLS policies check auth.uid()        │
+│                                          │
+└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
+```
+
+### 3. Supabase Client Pattern
+
+Guvenli veri erisimi icin iki farkli client:
+
+#### Browser Client (Client Components)
+
+```typescript
+// lib/supabase/client.ts
+import { createBrowserClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
+
+export function createClient() {
+  return createBrowserClient(
+    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
+    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!
+  )
+}
+```
+
+**Kullanim:**
+- Client components
+- Browser-side veri cekme
+- Realtime subscriptions
+
+#### Server Client (Server Components & Actions)
+
+```typescript
+// lib/supabase/server.ts
+import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
+import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
+
+export async function createServerSupabaseClient() {
+  const cookieStore = await cookies()
+
+  return createServerClient(
+    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
+    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
+    {
+      cookies: {
+        get: (name) => cookieStore.get(name)?.value,
+        set: (name, value, options) => cookieStore.set(name, value, options),
+        remove: (name, options) => cookieStore.set(name, '', options)
+      }
+    }
+  )
+}
+```
+
+**Kullanim:**
+- Server components
+- Server actions
+- API routes
+- Middleware

+## Veri Akis Patterni
+
+### Server-First Yaklasim
+
+Next.js App Router'in server-first yaklasimini kullaniyoruz:
+
+```
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│           Data Fetching Flow                │
+├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
+│                                             │
+│  1. Server Component renders                │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  2. Fetch data using Server Client          │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  3. RLS filters data automatically          │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  4. Return JSX with data                    │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  5. Stream to client                        │
+│                                             │
+└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
+```
+
+### Mutation Pattern (Server Actions)
+
+Form submissions ve mutations icin Server Actions kullaniyoruz:
+
+```typescript
+// app/(dashboard)/products/actions.ts
+'use server'
+
+import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
+import { createServerSupabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
+
+export async function updateProductPrice(
+  productId: string,
+  newPrice: number,
+  reason: string
+) {
+  const supabase = await createServerSupabaseClient()
+
+  // Get current user
+  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
+  if (!user) throw new Error('Unauthorized')
+
+  // Insert new price (INSERT-only pattern)
+  const { error } = await supabase
+    .from('price_ledger')
+    .insert({
+      product_id: productId,
+      price: newPrice,
+      change_reason: reason,
+      changed_by: user.id
+    })
+
+  if (error) throw error
+
+  // Revalidate cached pages
+  revalidatePath('/dashboard/products')
+
+  return { success: true }
+}
+```

+## Degismez Fiyat Defteri
+
+### Neden Immutable Pattern?
+
+1. **Hukuki Gereklilik**: Ticaret Bakanligi regulasyonlari fiyat gecmisinin korunmasini zorunlu kilir
+2. **Audit Trail**: Her fiyat degisikligi kim tarafindan, ne zaman, neden yapildi takip edilebilir
+3. **Kanit Niteligi**: Denetim sirasinda gosterilecek degismez kayitlar
+
+### Fiyat Degistirme Akisi
+
+```
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│       Price Change Workflow                 │
+├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
+│                                             │
+│  1. Manager initiates price change          │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  2. System checks permission                │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  3. INSERT new row to price_ledger          │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  4. Trigger creates menu snapshot           │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  5. Calculate SHA-256 hash of menu state    │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  6. Store snapshot with timestamp           │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  7. Create audit log entry                  │
+│                                             │
+└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
+```
+
+### Kod Ornegi
+
+```typescript
+// YANLIS: Fiyati UPDATE ile degistirme
+await supabase
+  .from('products')
+  .update({ price: 150 })
+  .eq('id', productId)
+// ❌ BU YAKLASIM YASAK!
+
+// DOGRU: Yeni fiyat kaydi INSERT
+await supabase
+  .from('price_ledger')
+  .insert({
+    product_id: productId,

+// ✅ DOGRU YAKLASIM

+## Feature Flag Sistemi
+
+### Dinamik Paket Yonetimi
+
+Hard-coded paket kontrolleri yerine veritabani tabanli dinamik sistem:
+
+### Features Tablosu
+

+  category feature_category NOT NULL

+**Ornek Feature Kayitlari:**

+| `limit_categories` | Kategori Limiti | limit |
+| `design_custom_colors` | Ozel Renkler | design |

+
+### Plans & Plan Features
+

+
+### Permission Guard
+
+```typescript
+// lib/guards/permission.ts
+import { createServerSupabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
+
+export async function hasPermission(
+  organizationId: string,
+  featureKey: string
+): Promise<boolean> {
+  const supabase = await createServerSupabaseClient()
+
+  // Get organization's active subscription
+  const { data: subscription } = await supabase
+    .from('subscriptions')
+    .select(`
+      plan_id,
+      plans!inner(
+        plan_features!inner(
+          features!inner(feature_key)
+        )
+      )
+    `)
+    .eq('organization_id', organizationId)
+    .eq('status', 'active')
+    .single()
+
+  if (!subscription) return false
+
+  // Check if feature exists in plan
+  const hasFeature = subscription.plans.plan_features.some(
+    pf => pf.features.feature_key === featureKey
+  )
+
+  return hasFeature
+}
+```
+

+

+## Rollendirme ve Yetkilendirme
+
+### Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
+
+5 farkli rol seviyesi:
+
+| Role | Yetkiler | Kullanim Alani |
+|------|----------|----------------|
+| `owner` | Tum yetkiler + faturalandirma | Isletme sahibi |
+| `admin` | Kullanici yonetimi dahil tum yetkiler | Yonetici |
+| `manager` | Urun, kategori, fiyat yonetimi | Mudur |
+| `waiter` | Sadece servis talepleri | Garson |
+| `viewer` | Sadece okuma yetkisi | Muhasebe, raporlama |
+
+### Permission Checker
+
+```typescript
+// lib/guards/role.ts
+type UserRole = 'owner' | 'admin' | 'manager' | 'waiter' | 'viewer'
+
+const roleHierarchy: Record<UserRole, number> = {
+  owner: 5,
+  admin: 4,
+  manager: 3,
+  waiter: 2,
+  viewer: 1
+}
+
+export function hasMinimumRole(
+  userRole: UserRole,
+  requiredRole: UserRole
+): boolean {
+  return roleHierarchy[userRole] >= roleHierarchy[requiredRole]
+}
+```

+### Supabase Realtime
+
+Garson cagirma sistemi icin WebSocket tabanli realtime iletisim:
+
+```
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│         Realtime Flow                       │
+├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
+│                                             │
+│  Customer (Public Menu)                     │
+│     │                                       │
+│     │ 1. Click "Garson Cagir"               │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  INSERT service_requests                    │
+│     │                                       │
+│     │ 2. Database change                    │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  Supabase Realtime broadcasts               │
+│     │                                       │
+│     │ 3. WebSocket push                     │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  Waiter Panel (subscribed)                  │
+│     │                                       │
+│     │ 4. Show notification                  │
+│     ↓                                       │
+│  Waiter responds                            │
+│                                             │
+└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
+```
+
+### Subscription Ornegi
+
+```typescript
+// components/waiter/ServiceRequestsMonitor.tsx
+'use client'
+
+import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
+import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
+
+export function ServiceRequestsMonitor({ orgId }: Props) {
+  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([])
+  const supabase = createClient()
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    // Subscribe to new service requests
+    const channel = supabase
+      .channel('service_requests')
+      .on(
+        'postgres_changes',
+        {
+          event: 'INSERT',
+          schema: 'public',
+          table: 'service_requests',
+          filter: `organization_id=eq.${orgId}`
+        },
+        (payload) => {
+          // Show notification
+          showNotification(payload.new)
+
+          // Update state
+          setRequests(prev => [...prev, payload.new])
+        }
+      )
+      .subscribe()
+
+    return () => {
+      supabase.removeChannel(channel)
+    }
+  }, [orgId])
+
+  return <RequestsList requests={requests} />
+}
+```

+
+export async function generateTableQR(
+  orgSlug: string,
+  tableId: string
+): Promise<string> {
+  const url = `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/menu/${orgSlug}?table=${tableId}`
+
+  // Generate QR code as data URL
+  const qrDataUrl = await QRCode.toDataURL(url, {

+## Audit ve Compliance
+
+### Menu Snapshots
+
+Her fiyat degisikliginde menu durumu "donduruluyor":
+
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE menu_snapshots (
+  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id),
+  snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
+  snapshot_data JSONB NOT NULL,
+  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
+);
+```
+
+### Snapshot Trigger
+
+```sql
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION create_menu_snapshot()
+RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
+DECLARE
+  menu_data JSONB;
+  hash_value TEXT;
+BEGIN
+  -- Get current menu state
+  SELECT jsonb_agg(
+    jsonb_build_object(
+      'product_id', p.id,
+      'name', p.name,
+      'price', pl.price,
+      'effective_from', pl.effective_from
+    )
+  )
+  INTO menu_data
+  FROM products p
+  JOIN current_prices pl ON p.id = pl.product_id
+  WHERE p.organization_id = (
+    SELECT organization_id FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id
+  );
+
+  -- Calculate SHA-256 hash
+  hash_value := encode(
+    digest(menu_data::text, 'sha256'),
+    'hex'
+  );
+
+  -- Insert snapshot
+  INSERT INTO menu_snapshots (
+    organization_id,
+    snapshot_hash,
+    snapshot_data
+  )
+  SELECT organization_id, hash_value, menu_data
+  FROM products WHERE id = NEW.product_id;
+
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
+
+-- Trigger on price_ledger INSERT
+CREATE TRIGGER auto_menu_snapshot
+  AFTER INSERT ON price_ledger
+  FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION create_menu_snapshot();
+```
+
+### Audit Logs
+
+Tum kritik islemlerin kaydi:
+
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
+  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id),
+  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
+  action TEXT NOT NULL,
+  entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
+  entity_id UUID,
+  metadata JSONB,
+  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
+);
+```
+
+---
+
+## Performans ve Olceklendirme
+
+### Database Optimizasyonlari
+
+#### Indexler
+
+```sql
+-- Organizations slug lookup
+CREATE INDEX idx_organizations_slug ON organizations(slug);
+
+-- Price ledger product lookup
+CREATE INDEX idx_price_ledger_product_effective
+  ON price_ledger(product_id, effective_from DESC);
+
+-- Organization members user lookup
+CREATE INDEX idx_org_members_user
+  ON organization_members(user_id);
+
+-- Service requests organization and status
+CREATE INDEX idx_service_requests_org_status
+  ON service_requests(organization_id, status);
+```
+
+#### Connection Pooling
+
+Supabase otomatik connection pooling saglar:
+- **Direct Connection**: 60 concurrent
+- **Pooler**: 200+ concurrent (production icin onerilen)
+
+### Caching Strategy
+
+Next.js App Router caching layers:
+
+```typescript
+// Static rendering (build-time)
+export default async function ProductsPage() {
+  // Cached at build time
+  const products = await fetchProducts()
+  return <ProductsList products={products} />
+}
+
+// Dynamic rendering with cache
+export const revalidate = 3600 // 1 hour
+
+// Opt out of caching
+export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
+export const revalidate = 0
+```
+
+---
+
+## Deployment Mimarisi
+
+### Production Stack
+
+```
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│         Production Architecture             │
+├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
+│                                             │
+│  ┌──────────────┐                           │
+│  │   Vercel     │  (Frontend + SSR)         │
+│  │  Edge Network│                           │
+│  └──────┬───────┘                           │
+│         │                                   │
+│         ▼                                   │
+│  ┌──────────────┐                           │
+│  │  Supabase    │  (Backend + Database)     │
+│  │  - PostgreSQL│                           │
+│  │  - Auth      │                           │
+│  │  - Realtime  │                           │
+│  │  - Storage   │                           │
+│  └──────────────┘                           │
+│                                             │
+└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
+```
+
+### Vercel Edge Network
+
+- **Global CDN**: Dunya genelinde dusuk latency
+- **Automatic SSL**: HTTPS otomatik
+- **Serverless Functions**: Auto-scaling API routes
+
+### Supabase Infrastructure
+
+- **Multi-region**: US East (primary)
+- **Daily Backups**: Otomatik veritabani yedekleme
+- **Point-in-time Recovery**: 7 gun geri alim
+
+---
+
+## Tasarim Kararlari
+
+### 1. Neden INSERT-only Price Ledger?
+
+**Karar**: Fiyat degisiklikleri UPDATE yerine INSERT ile yapilir.
+
+**Gerekce:**
+- ✅ Hukuki uyumluluk: Ticaret Bakanligi gereksinimleri
+- ✅ Audit trail: Tum degisiklikler kayitli
+- ✅ Kanit niteligi: Degismez kayitlar
+- ❌ Dezavantaj: Daha fazla disk kullanimi (kabul edilebilir)
+
+### 2. Neden Multi-Tenant Single Database?
+
+**Karar**: Tum isletmeler ayni database'de, RLS ile izole.
+
+**Alternatifler:**
+- Database per tenant: Yonetim zorlugu, maliyet yuksek
+- Schema per tenant: Karmasik migration yonetimi
+
+**Secim Gerekceleri:**
+- ✅ Kolay yonetim ve backup
+- ✅ Dusuk maliyet
+- ✅ Supabase RLS cok guvenilir
+- ✅ Kolay olceklendirme
+
+### 3. Neden Supabase?
+
+**Karar**: Backend olarak Supabase kullanimi.
+
+**Alternatifler:**
+- Custom Node.js backend
+- Firebase
+- AWS Amplify
+
+**Secim Gerekceleri:**
+- ✅ PostgreSQL (gercek iliskisel DB)
+- ✅ Built-in RLS
+- ✅ Realtime out-of-the-box
+- ✅ Auth ve Storage dahil
+- ✅ Turk startups icin uygun fiyat
+
+### 4. Neden Server Components First?
+
+**Karar**: Varsayilan olarak Server Components kullanimi.
+
+**Gerekce:**
+- ✅ Daha iyi SEO (server-rendered)
+- ✅ Daha kucuk bundle size
+- ✅ Guvenli veri erisimi (RLS server-side)
+- ✅ Automatic code splitting
+
+---
+
+## Ozet
+
+ozaMenu mimarisi asagidaki prensiplere dayanir:
+
+1. **Immutability**: Fiyat kayitlari degismez
+2. **Multi-Tenancy**: RLS ile veri izolasyonu
+3. **Security-First**: Her seviyede guvenlik kontrolleri
+4. **Compliance**: Hukuki gereksinimlere tam uyum
+5. **Scalability**: Buyumeye hazir altyapi
+6. **Developer Experience**: Modern tooling ve best practices
+
+Bu dokuman platformun teknik temellerini aciklar. Daha detayli bilgi icin ilgili bolum dokumantasyonlarina bakiniz.
+

+# ozaMenu - Veritabani Şema Dokumantasyonu
+
+[![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-16-blue?logo=postgresql)](https://www.postgresql.org/)
+[![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-RLS%20Enabled-green?logo=supabase)](https://supabase.com/)
+[![Compliance](https://img.shields.io/badge/Compliance-TR%20Ticaret%20Bakanligi-red)]()
+
+**ozaMenu platformunun veritabani şeması, Turkiye Ticaret Bakanligi regulasyonlarina uyumlu, degişmez fiyat kayit sistemi ve multi-tenant mimarisi icin tasarlanmiştir.**
+
+## Icindekiler
+
+- [Veritabani Hakkinda](#veritabani-hakkinda)
+- [Mimari Prensipler](#mimari-prensipler)
+- [Migrasyon Dosyalari](#migrasyon-dosyalari)
+- [Temel Tablolar](#temel-tablolar)
+  - [001: Core Tables](#001-core-tables)
+  - [002: Products & Price Ledger](#002-products--price-ledger)
+  - [003: Package Management](#003-package-management)
+  - [004: Tables & Service Requests](#004-tables--service-requests)
+  - [005: Audit & Compliance](#005-audit--compliance)
+- [Veritabani Görünümleri (Views)](#veritabani-gorumlumleri-views)
+  - [006: Database Views](#006-database-views)
+- [Guvenlik ve Yetkilendirme](#guvenlik-ve-yetkilendirme)
+  - [007: Row Level Security (RLS) Policies](#007-row-level-security-rls-policies)
+- [Otomatik İşlemler](#otomatik-islemler)
+  - [010: Auto Snapshot Trigger](#010-auto-snapshot-trigger)
+- [Şema İlişkileri](#sema-iliskileri)
+- [Kullanim Örnekleri](#kullanim-ornekleri)
+- [Anti-Patterns ve Dikkat Edilmesi Gerekenler](#anti-patterns-ve-dikkat-edilmesi-gerekenler)
+
+---
+
+## Veritabani Hakkinda
+
+ozaMenu veritabani şeması, yasal uyumluluk gereksinimleri ve çok kiracili (multi-tenant) SaaS mimarisi goz onunde bulundurularak tasarlanmiştir. Veritabani, sadece uygulama verisini saklamakla kalmaz, ayni zamanda **yasal olarak gecerli, denetlenebilir ve degişmez fiyat kayitlari** tutar.
+
+### Temel Ozellikler
+
+- **Degişmez Fiyat Defteri (Immutable Price Ledger)**: `price_ledger` tablosu INSERT-only pattern kullanir, UPDATE/DELETE işlemleri trigger ile engellenir
+- **Row Level Security (RLS)**: Her isletme sadece kendi verisine erişebilir, multi-tenant izolasyon garantilenir
+- **Kriptografik Dogrulama**: Her fiyat degişikliginde menu durumu SHA-256 hash ile kayit altina alinir
+- **Dinamik Feature Management**: Tum paket özellikleri veritabanindan yönetilir, hard-coded limit yoktur
+- **Audit Trail**: Tüm kritik işlemler `audit_logs` tablosunda kayit altina alinir
+- **Realtime Ready**: Supabase Realtime ile uyumlu, garson bildirimleri icin optimize edilmiştir
+
+### Compliance Gereksinimleri
+
+Bu veritabani şeması, **Turkiye Cumhuriyeti Ticaret Bakanligi'nin Fiyat Etiketleme ve Fiyat Bildirme Yonetmeligi** gereksinimlerine uygun olarak tasarlanmiştir:
+
+1. **Fiyat Degişiklik Kaydi**: Her fiyat degişikligi tarih, saat ve eski fiyat ile birlikte kayit altina alinir
+2. **Degişmezlik**: Gecmiş fiyat kayitlari asla degiştirilmez veya silinemez
+3. **Denetlenebilirlik**: Herhangi bir tarihte menu durumu ve fiyatlari yeniden olusturulabilir
+4. **Kriptografik Kanit**: Menu snapshot'lari SHA-256 hash ile dogrulanabilir
+
+---
+
+## Mimari Prensipler
+
+### 1. Multi-Tenant İzolasyon
+
+Her `organization` (isletme) veritabaninda tamamen izole edilmiştir:
+
+```
+organizations (isletme)
+    ↓
+organization_members (kullanicilar ve rolleri)
+    ↓
+RLS Policies (her tablo icin)
+    ↓
+Veri İzolasyonu (isletmeler arasi)
+```
+
+- Her kullanici bir veya daha fazla isletmeye uye olabilir
+- Her isletmedeki rol (owner, admin, manager, waiter, viewer) RLS politikalari ile kontrol edilir
+- Isletmeler arasi veri sizintisi imkansiz hale getirilmiştir
+
+### 2. INSERT-Only Price Ledger Pattern
+
+Fiyat defteri (price_ledger) degişmez bir kayit sistemidir:
+
+```sql
+-- ✅ DOĞRU: Yeni fiyat ekleme
+INSERT INTO price_ledger (product_id, price, effective_from)
+VALUES ('product-uuid', 99.99, NOW());
+
+-- ❌ YANLIŞ: Mevcut fiyati guncelleme (TRIGGER TARAFINDAN ENGELLENIR!)
+UPDATE price_ledger SET price = 89.99 WHERE id = 'ledger-uuid';
+
+-- ❌ YANLIŞ: Fiyat silme (TRIGGER TARAFINDAN ENGELLENIR!)
+DELETE FROM price_ledger WHERE id = 'ledger-uuid';
+```
+
+### 3. Current State via Views
+
+Guncel durum (current prices, active subscriptions) immutable tablolardan view'lar ile elde edilir:
+
+```
+price_ledger (tum fiyat gecmisi)
+    ↓
+current_prices VIEW (her urun icin gecerli fiyat)
+    ↓
+Uygulama (guncel fiyatlari kullanir)
+```
+
+Bu sayede:
+- Gecmiş verilere mudahale edilmez
+- Guncel durum her zaman hesaplanabilir
+- Audit trail korunur
+
+### 4. Feature Flag System
+
+Paket ozellikleri dinamik olarak yonetilir:
+
+```
+features (platform ozellikleri)
+    ↓
+plans (paketler: free, basic, premium)
+    ↓
+subscriptions (isletme abonelikleri)
+    ↓
+feature_overrides (ozel izinler)
+    ↓
+Erisim Kontrolu
+```
+
+Hard-coded limit yerine:
+- Yeni ozellikler `features` tablosuna eklenir
+- Paketler bu ozellikleri icerir
+- Isletmelere ozel izinler verilebilir
+- Tum kontrol veritabaninda
+
+---
+
+## Migrasyon Dosyalari
+
+Veritabani şeması asagidaki migrasyon dosyalari ile olusturulmuştur. Her migrasyon numarasi sirali calistirilmalidir:
+
+| Dosya | Aciklama | Tablolar | Kritik Ozellik |
+|-------|----------|----------|----------------|
+| `001_core_tables.sql` | Temel isletme ve kategori tablolari | organizations, organization_members, categories | Multi-tenant temel |
+| `002_products_price_ledger.sql` | Urunler ve degismez fiyat defteri | products, price_ledger | **Immutable Pattern** |
+| `003_package_management.sql` | Paket ve abonelik yonetimi | features, plans, subscriptions, feature_overrides | Dynamic Features |
+| `004_tables_service_requests.sql` | Masa QR sistemi ve garson bildirimleri | tables, service_requests | Realtime System |
+| `005_audit_compliance.sql` | Denetim kayitlari ve menu snapshot'lari | menu_snapshots, audit_logs | SHA-256 Compliance |
+| `006_views.sql` | Veritabani gorunumleri | current_prices VIEW | Current State |
+| `007_rls_policies.sql` | Row Level Security politikalari | (RLS policies for all tables) | **Security Core** |
+| `010_auto_snapshot_trigger.sql` | Otomatik snapshot olusturma | (trigger function) | Auto Compliance |
+
+> **Not**: Migrasyon 008 ve 009 atlanmiştir (gelecekte kullanilmak uzere rezerve edilmiştir).
+
+---
+
+## Temel Tablolar
+
+### 001: Core Tables
+
+`001_core_tables.sql` migrasyonu, ozaMenu platformunun multi-tenant mimarisinin temelini olusturan uc kritik tablo icerir. Bu tablolar, isletme yonetimi, kullanici yetkilendirmesi ve kategori organizasyonu icin gerekli altyapiyi saglar.
+
+#### organizations
+
+**İşletme bilgilerini saklayan ana tablo.** Her kayit bir isletmeyi (restoran, kafe, pastane vb.) temsil eder ve platformdaki tum diger verinin organization_id ile bu tabloya baglanir.
+
+| Kolon | Tip | Constraint | Aciklama |
+|-------|-----|------------|----------|
+| `id` | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() | Isletmenin benzersiz kimlik numarasi |
+| `name` | VARCHAR(255) | NOT NULL | Isletmenin resmi adi (ornek: "Cafe Mola") |
+| `slug` | VARCHAR(255) | UNIQUE, NOT NULL | URL-safe isletme kimligi (ornek: "cafe-mola-ankara") |
+| `created_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Kayit olusturma zamani |
+| `updated_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Son guncelleme zamani |
+| `settings` | JSONB | DEFAULT '{}' | Isletmeye ozel ayarlar (tema, logo URL, iletisim bilgileri) |
+| `is_active` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Isletme aktif mi? (super admin tarafindan devre disi birakilabilir) |
+| `tier` | VARCHAR(50) | DEFAULT 'free' | Mevcut paket seviyesi (opsiyonel, subscriptions tablosu tercih edilir) |
+
+**Onemli Notlar:**
+- `slug` kolonu QR menu URL'lerinde kullanilir: `https://ozamenu.com/menu/cafe-mola-ankara`
+- `settings` JSONB kolonu asagidaki gibi verileri saklar:
+  ```json
+  {
+    "logo_url": "https://storage.supabase.co/...",
+    "primary_color": "#FF6B35",
+    "contact_email": "info@cafemola.com",
+    "contact_phone": "+90 555 123 4567"
+  }
+  ```
+- Her isletme icin `is_active` kontrolu RLS politikalarinda yapilmalidir
+- `tier` kolonu legacy amacidir; dinamik paket yonetimi icin `subscriptions` tablosu kullanilmalidir
+
+**Ornek Kayit:**
+```sql
+INSERT INTO organizations (name, slug, settings)
+VALUES (
+  'Cafe Mola Ankara',
+  'cafe-mola-ankara',
+  '{"logo_url": "https://example.com/logo.png", "primary_color": "#FF6B35"}'::jsonb
+);
+```
+
+---
+
+#### organization_members
+
+**İşletme-kullanici iliskisini ve rolleri saklayan many-to-many junction tablo.** Bir kullanici birden fazla isletmeye uye olabilir ve her isletmede farkli rol'e sahip olabilir.
+
+| Kolon | Tip | Constraint | Aciklama |
+|-------|-----|------------|----------|
+| `id` | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() | Uyelik kayit kimlik numarasi |
+| `organization_id` | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE | Isletme referansi |
+| `user_id` | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE | Supabase Auth kullanici referansi |
+| `role` | VARCHAR(50) | NOT NULL, CHECK (role IN (...)) | Kullanicinin isletmedeki rolu |
+| `created_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Uyelik olusturma zamani |
+| `invited_by` | UUID | FOREIGN KEY → auth.users(id) | Bu kullaniciyi davet eden kisi (opsiyonel) |
+| `joined_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | DEFAULT NOW() | Daveti kabul etme zamani |
+
+**Unique Constraint:** `UNIQUE(organization_id, user_id)` - Bir kullanici ayni isletmeye birden fazla kez uye olamaz.
+
+**Roller (RBAC):**
+
+| Role | Aciklama | Izinler |
+|------|----------|---------|
+| `owner` | Isletme sahibi (tam yetki) | Tum islemler, isletmeyi silme, paket degisikligi, uye yonetimi |
+| `admin` | Yonetici | Urun, fiyat, kategori, masa yonetimi; uye ekleme/cikartma |
+| `manager` | Mudur | Urun, fiyat guncelleme; raporlari goruntuleme |
+| `waiter` | Garson | Sadece servis talepleri gorme ve yanitlema |
+| `viewer` | Goruntuleyici | Sadece okuma yetkisi (raporlar, menu) |
+
+**Onemli Notlar:**
+- Her isletmede **en az bir `owner` olmalidir** (business rule)
+- `user_id` Supabase Auth'daki `auth.users` tablosuna referans verir
+- RLS politikalari `organization_members` tablosunu kullanarak erisim kontrolu yapar:
+  ```sql
+  -- Ornek RLS Policy
+  CREATE POLICY "Users can view their organizations' data"
+  ON products FOR SELECT
+  USING (
+    organization_id IN (
+      SELECT organization_id FROM organization_members
+      WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
+    )
+  );
+  ```
+- `invited_by` kolonu audit trail icin kullanilir (kim, kimi davet etti?)
+
+**Ornek Kayit:**
+```sql
+-- Owner ekleme
+INSERT INTO organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role)
+VALUES ('org-uuid', 'user-uuid', 'owner');
+
+-- Garson davet etme
+INSERT INTO organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role, invited_by)
+VALUES ('org-uuid', 'waiter-user-uuid', 'waiter', 'admin-user-uuid');
+```
+
+---
+
+#### categories
+
+**Ürün kategorilerini saklayan tablo.** Her isletme kendi kategori yapisini olusturur (Icecekler, Tatlilar, Ana Yemekler vb.).
+
+| Kolon | Tip | Constraint | Aciklama |
+|-------|-----|------------|----------|
+| `id` | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() | Kategori kimlik numarasi |
+| `organization_id` | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE | Kategori hangi isletmeye ait |
+| `name` | VARCHAR(255) | NOT NULL | Kategori adi (ornek: "Sicak Icecekler") |
+| `slug` | VARCHAR(255) | NOT NULL | URL-safe kategori kimligi (ornek: "sicak-icecekler") |
+| `description` | TEXT | | Kategori aciklamasi (opsiyonel) |
+| `display_order` | INTEGER | NOT NULL, DEFAULT 0 | Menude gosterim sirasi (kucuk numara once) |
+| `is_active` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Kategori aktif mi? |
+| `created_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Olusturma zamani |
+| `updated_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Guncelleme zamani |
+| `icon` | VARCHAR(255) | | Kategori ikonu (emoji veya icon ismi) |
+
+**Unique Constraint:** `UNIQUE(organization_id, slug)` - Ayni isletme icinde kategori slug'lari benzersiz olmalidir.
+
+**Onemli Notlar:**
+- `display_order` kolonu frontend'de kategorilerin sirasini belirler
+- `slug` kolonu menu URL'lerinde kullanilir: `https://ozamenu.com/menu/cafe-mola#sicak-icecekler`
+- `is_active = false` kategoriler menu'de gosterilmez ama silinmez (soft delete)
+- Kategori silindiginde (`ON DELETE CASCADE`), o kategorideki tum urunler de silinir (**DIKKAT!**)
+- `icon` kolonu genellikle emoji icerir: "☕", "🍰", "🍔"
+
+**Paket Sinirlari:**
+- **Free paket**: Maksimum 3 kategori
+- **Professional ve Premium paketler**: Sinirsiz kategori
+- Sinir kontrolu `features` tablosu ve `feature_overrides` ile dinamik olarak yonetilir
+
+**Ornek Kayit:**
+```sql
+-- Sicak Icecekler kategorisi
+INSERT INTO categories (organization_id, name, slug, display_order, icon)
+VALUES (
+  'org-uuid',
+  'Sıcak İçecekler',
+  'sicak-icecekler',
+  1,
+  '☕'
+);
+
+-- Tatlilar kategorisi
+INSERT INTO categories (organization_id, name, slug, display_order, icon, description)
+VALUES (
+  'org-uuid',
+  'Tatlılar',
+  'tatlilar',
+  2,
+  '🍰',
+  'Evde yapılmış özel tatlılarımız'
+);
+```
+
+---
+
+#### Tablo İlişkileri (001 Migration)
+
+```
+organizations (1) ──────┬──────> (N) organization_members
+                        │
+                        └──────> (N) categories
+                        │
+                        └──────> (N) products (002 migration)
+                        │
+                        └──────> (N) subscriptions (003 migration)
+                        │
+                        └──────> (N) tables (004 migration)
+```
+
+**Cascade Silme Davranisi:**
+- `organizations` silindiginde → **TUM** iliskili veriler silinir (members, categories, products, vb.)
+- `categories` silindiginde → O kategorideki **TUM** urunler silinir
+- `organization_members` silindiginde → Sadece uyelik kaydi silinir, kullanici (auth.users) korunur
+
+**RLS Politika Stratejisi:**
+
+Tum core tablolar icin RLS aktiftir ve asagidaki stratejiye sahiptir:
+
+1. **SELECT**: Kullanici sadece uye oldugu isletmelerin verilerini gorebilir
+   ```sql
+   organization_id IN (
+     SELECT organization_id FROM organization_members
+     WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
+   )
+   ```
+
+2. **INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE**: Rol bazli yetkilendirme
+   ```sql
+   -- Sadece owner ve admin INSERT yapabilir
+   EXISTS (
+     SELECT 1 FROM organization_members
+     WHERE organization_id = categories.organization_id
+       AND user_id = auth.uid()
+       AND role IN ('owner', 'admin')
+   )
+   ```
+
+**Anti-Patterns (Yapilmamasi Gerekenler):**
+
+❌ **YANLIŞ: Isletme kontrolu olmadan veri ekleme**
+```sql
+-- RLS bypass edilmis! (service_role key kullanilmis)
+INSERT INTO categories (name, slug) VALUES ('Test', 'test');
+-- Hata: organization_id eksik!
+```
+
+✅ **DOĞRU: Isletme ID ile veri ekleme**
+```sql
+INSERT INTO categories (organization_id, name, slug)
+VALUES (
+  (SELECT organization_id FROM organization_members
+   WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1),
+  'Test',
+  'test'
+);
+```
+
+❌ **YANLIŞ: Hard-coded admin kontrolu**
+```typescript
+// Backend kodunda
+if (user.email === 'admin@ozamenu.com') {
+  // Admin islemleri
+}
+```
+
+✅ **DOĞRU: Rol bazli yetkilendirme**
+```typescript
+const { data: membership } = await supabase
+  .from('organization_members')
+  .select('role')
+  .eq('organization_id', orgId)
+  .eq('user_id', userId)
+  .single();
+
+if (['owner', 'admin'].includes(membership.role)) {
+  // Admin islemleri
+}
+```
+
+---
+
+### 002: Products & Price Ledger
+
+`002_products_price_ledger.sql` migrasyonu, ozaMenu platformunun en kritik compliance gereksinimini karsilayan iki tablo icerir: **urun bilgilerini saklayan products tablosu** ve **degismez fiyat kayitlari tutan price_ledger tablosu**. Bu migrasyon, Turkiye Ticaret Bakanligi'nin fiyat seffafligi ve kayit tutma yonetmeliklerine uyum saglayan INSERT-only pattern'i uygular.
+
+#### products
+
+**Urun bilgilerini saklayan ana tablo.** Her kayit bir menu urunu (yemek, icecek, tatli vb.) temsil eder. Onemli: Fiyat bilgisi bu tabloda SAKLANMAZ, sadece `price_ledger` tablosunda tutulur.
+
+| Kolon | Tip | Constraint | Aciklama |
+|-------|-----|------------|----------|
+| `id` | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() | Urunun benzersiz kimlik numarasi |
+| `organization_id` | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE | Urun hangi isletmeye ait |
+| `category_id` | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → categories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE | Urun hangi kategoriye ait |
+| `name` | VARCHAR(255) | NOT NULL | Urun adi (ornek: "Cappuccino", "Izgara Tavuk") |
+| `description` | TEXT | | Urun aciklamasi (malzemeler, hazirlanisi vb.) |
+| `image_url` | TEXT | | Urun gorseli URL'i (Supabase Storage'da saklanir) |
+| `is_active` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Urun menu'de gosterilsin mi? |
+| `created_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Kayit olusturma zamani |

+- **FIYAT BU TABLODA YOK!** Fiyatlar `price_ledger` tablosunda saklanir, guncel fiyat `current_prices` view'dan elde edilir
+- `is_active = false` urunler menu'de gosterilmez ama veritabaninda korunur (soft delete pattern)

+#### price_ledger
+
+**KRITIK: Degismez fiyat kayit defteri.** Bu tablo, Turkiye Ticaret Bakanligi'nin fiyat seffafligi ve kayit tutma yonetmeliklerine uyum saglayan **immutable (degismez) bir ledger sistemi**dir. Tum fiyat degisiklikleri burada INSERT-only pattern ile saklanir, UPDATE ve DELETE islemleri **database trigger tarafindan engellenmiştir**.
+
+| Kolon | Tip | Constraint | Aciklama |
+|-------|-----|------------|----------|
+| `id` | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() | Fiyat kayit kimlik numarasi |
+| `product_id` | UUID | NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY → products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE | Hangi urunun fiyati |
+| `price` | DECIMAL(10,2) | NOT NULL, CHECK (price >= 0) | Fiyat (TL cinsinden, 2 ondalik basamak) |
+| `effective_from` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Bu fiyat ne zaman gecerli oldu |
+| `created_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Kayit ne zaman olusturuldu |
+| `created_by` | UUID | FOREIGN KEY → auth.users(id) | Kim bu fiyat degisikligini yapti |
+| `change_reason` | TEXT | | Fiyat degisikligi sebebi (ornek: "Yeni sezon fiyati") |
+| `previous_price` | DECIMAL(10,2) | | Bir onceki fiyat (audit trail icin) |
+
+**IMMUTABILITY PATTERN - Degismezlik Kurali:**
+
+Bu tabloda **UPDATE ve DELETE YASAKTIR!** Asagidaki database trigger ile engellenmistir:
+
+```sql
+-- Bu trigger price_ledger tablosunda UPDATE/DELETE islemlerini engeller
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prevent_price_ledger_modifications()
+RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
+BEGIN
+  RAISE EXCEPTION 'price_ledger tablosu immutable (degismez)dir. UPDATE ve DELETE islemleri YASAKTIR. Yeni fiyat eklemek icin INSERT kullanin.';
+END;
+$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER prevent_update_delete_on_price_ledger
+  BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON price_ledger
+  FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_price_ledger_modifications();
+```
+
+**Neden Degismezlik Gerekli?**
+
+1. **Turkiye Ticaret Bakanligi Uyumlulugu**:
+   - Fiyat Etiketi Yonetmeligi, isletmelerin fiyat degisikliklerini kayit altinda tutmasini zorunlu kilar
+   - Denetim sirasinda herhangi bir tarihteki fiyat ispat edilebilmeli
+   - Fiyat kayitlari **asla degismemeli, silinmemeli**
+
+2. **Hukuki Kanit Niteliginde Veri**:
+   - Musteri sikayet/itiraz durumunda siparis anindaki fiyat ispat edilebilir
+   - Vergi denetiminde fiyat gecmisi gosterilebilir
+   - Fiyat manipulasyonu onlenir
+
+3. **Audit Trail (Denetim Izi)**:
+   - Her fiyat degisikligi kim tarafindan, ne zaman yapildi gorulebilir
+   - Fiyat artis/azalis trendi analiz edilebilir
+   - Hata durumunda rollback yerine yeni kayit eklenir
+
+4. **Veri Butunlugu**:
+   - Gecmis siparisler/raporlar dogru fiyat bilgisine sahip olur
+   - Menu snapshot'lari ile uyumlu calisir
+   - Time-travel query'leri mumkundur (belirli bir tarihteki menu durumu)
+
+**INSERT-Only Pattern Nasil Calisir?**
+
+Fiyat guncellemesi yapmak icin:
+
+```sql
+-- ❌ YANLIŞ: Mevcut fiyati guncellemeye calismak
+UPDATE price_ledger SET price = 150.00 WHERE product_id = 'product-uuid';
+-- HATA: price_ledger tablosu immutable (degismez)dir. UPDATE ve DELETE islemleri YASAKTIR.
+
+-- ✅ DOĞRU: Yeni fiyat kaydi eklemek
+INSERT INTO price_ledger (product_id, price, effective_from, created_by, change_reason, previous_price)
+VALUES (
+  'product-uuid',
+  150.00,
+  NOW(),
+  auth.uid(),
+  'Yeni sezon fiyat ayarlamasi',
+  (SELECT price FROM price_ledger WHERE product_id = 'product-uuid' ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1)
+);
+```
+
+**Fiyat Gecmisi Nasil Korunur?**
+
+Her urun icin tum fiyat gecmisi kronolojik olarak saklanir:
+
+```sql
+-- Bir urunun tum fiyat gecmisini gorme
+SELECT
+  price,
+  effective_from,
+  change_reason,
+  previous_price,
+  (price - previous_price) AS price_change,
+  ROUND(((price - previous_price) / NULLIF(previous_price, 0)) * 100, 2) AS change_percentage
+FROM price_ledger
+WHERE product_id = 'product-uuid'
+ORDER BY effective_from DESC;
+
+-- Sonuc:
+-- | price  | effective_from       | change_reason           | previous_price | price_change | change_percentage |
+-- |--------|---------------------|-------------------------|----------------|--------------|-------------------|
+-- | 150.00 | 2024-01-15 10:00:00 | Yeni sezon fiyat ayarla | 120.00         | 30.00        | 25.00             |
+-- | 120.00 | 2023-12-01 08:30:00 | Hammadde fiyat artisi   | 100.00         | 20.00        | 20.00             |
+-- | 100.00 | 2023-06-01 09:00:00 | Ilk fiyat               | NULL           | NULL         | NULL              |
+```
+
+**Guncel Fiyat Nasil Elde Edilir?**
+
+Guncel fiyatlar `current_prices` VIEW kullanilarak elde edilir (006 migrasyonunda tanimlanir):
+
+```sql
+-- current_prices VIEW kullanimi
+SELECT
+  p.name,
+  cp.price AS current_price,
+  cp.effective_from AS price_valid_since
+FROM products p
+JOIN current_prices cp ON p.id = cp.product_id
+WHERE p.organization_id = 'org-uuid'
+  AND p.is_active = true;
+```
+
+**Compliance Gereksinimleri:**
+
+Bu tablo asagidaki yasal yonetmeliklere uyum saglar:
+
+| Yonetmelik | Gereksinim | Nasil Karsilaniyor |
+|------------|------------|-------------------|
+| **Fiyat Etiketi Yonetmeligi** | Fiyat degisiklikleri kayit altinda tutulmali | Her fiyat degisikligi yeni satir olarak eklenir |
+| **Fiyat Bildirme Yonetmeligi** | Gecmis fiyatlar denetlenebilir olmali | effective_from kolonu ile zaman damgasi korunur |
+| **Tuketici Koruma Kanunu** | Fiyat manipulasyonu onlenmeli | UPDATE/DELETE trigger ile engellenir |
+| **Vergi Mevzuati** | Gelir/fiyat uyumu ispat edilebilir olmali | Tam audit trail mevcuttur |
+
+**Ornek Kayit:**
+```sql
+-- Yeni urun icin ilk fiyat
+INSERT INTO price_ledger (product_id, price, effective_from, created_by, change_reason)
+VALUES (
+  'product-uuid',
+  99.90,
+  NOW(),
+  'user-uuid',
+  'Yeni ürün ekleme'
+);
+
+-- Fiyat guncellemesi (yeni kayit olarak)
+INSERT INTO price_ledger (
+  product_id,
+  price,
+  effective_from,
+  created_by,
+  change_reason,
+  previous_price
+)
+VALUES (
+  'product-uuid',
+  119.90,
+  NOW(),
+  'user-uuid',
+  'Sezon sonu zammı',
+  99.90
+);
+```

+#### Tablo İlişkileri (002 Migration)
+
+```
+organizations (1) ──┐
+                    │
+categories (N)      │
+    │               │
+    └───> products (N) ────> price_ledger (N)
+                                    │
+                                    └───> current_prices VIEW (006 migration)
+```
+
+**Cascade Silme Davranisi:**
+- `products` silindiginde → O urunun TUM fiyat gecmisi silinir (ON DELETE CASCADE)
+- `categories` silindiginde → O kategorideki TUM urunler VE fiyat gecmisleri silinir
+- **UYARI**: Bu nedenle urun/kategori silme islemleri dikkatli yapilmalidir!
+
+**RLS Politika Stratejisi:**
+
+Hem `products` hem `price_ledger` tablolari RLS ile korunur:
+
+```sql
+-- products tablosu: Kullanici sadece kendi isletmesinin urunlerini gorebilir
+CREATE POLICY "Users can view their organization's products"
+ON products FOR SELECT
+USING (
+  organization_id IN (
+    SELECT organization_id FROM organization_members
+    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
+  )
+);
+
+-- price_ledger tablosu: Urun uzerinden izolasyon
+CREATE POLICY "Users can view price history of their products"
+ON price_ledger FOR SELECT
+USING (
+  product_id IN (
+    SELECT id FROM products
+    WHERE organization_id IN (
+      SELECT organization_id FROM organization_members
+      WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
+    )
+  )
+);
+
+-- price_ledger INSERT: Sadece owner, admin, manager fiyat ekleyebilir
+CREATE POLICY "Only managers can add prices"
+ON price_ledger FOR INSERT
+WITH CHECK (
+  EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM products p
+    JOIN organization_members om ON p.organization_id = om.organization_id
+    WHERE p.id = price_ledger.product_id
+      AND om.user_id = auth.uid()
+      AND om.role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'manager')
+  )
+);
+```
+
+**Otomatik Menu Snapshot:**
+
+Her fiyat degisikliginde otomatik olarak menu snapshot'i olusturulur (010 migrasyonunda tanimlanir):
+
+```sql
+-- Her INSERT'te calisacak trigger
+CREATE TRIGGER auto_create_menu_snapshot
+  AFTER INSERT ON price_ledger
+  FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION create_menu_snapshot();
+```
+
+Bu snapshot, menu durumunu SHA-256 hash ile kriptografik olarak dogrular.
+

+
+**Anti-Patterns (Yapilmamasi Gerekenler):**
+
+❌ **YANLIŞ: Fiyati products tablosunda saklamak**
+```sql
+ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN price DECIMAL(10,2); -- YAPMAYIN!
+-- Bu yaklasim fiyat gecmisini kaybettirir ve compliance ihlalidir!
+```
+
+✅ **DOĞRU: price_ledger ve current_prices VIEW kullanmak**
+```typescript
+// Frontend: Guncel fiyatli urunleri getirme
+const { data: products } = await supabase
+  .from('products')
+  .select(`
+    *,
+    current_price:current_prices(price, effective_from)
+  `)
+  .eq('organization_id', orgId)
+  .eq('is_active', true);
+```
+
+❌ **YANLIŞ: Fiyat hatasini UPDATE ile duzeltmeye calismak**
+```sql
+-- Yanlislikla 1000 TL yerine 100 TL girilmis, UPDATE ile duzeltmeye calismak
+UPDATE price_ledger SET price = 1000 WHERE id = 'ledger-uuid'; -- TRIGGER ENGELLER!
+```
+
+✅ **DOĞRU: Yeni dogru fiyat ekleyip aciklama yazmak**
+```sql
+-- Hatali kayit: 100 TL (yanlis)
+-- Dogru yaklasim: Yeni kayit ekle, change_reason'da acikla
+INSERT INTO price_ledger (product_id, price, effective_from, change_reason, previous_price)
+VALUES (
+  'product-uuid',
+  1000.00,
+  NOW(),
+  'Düzeltme: Önceki kayıt hatalıydı (100 TL yerine 1000 TL olacaktı)',
+  100.00
+);
+```
+
+❌ **YANLIŞ: Service role key ile RLS bypass edip UPDATE yapmak**
+```typescript
+// ASLA YAPMAYIN!
+const supabaseAdmin = createClient(url, SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);
+await supabaseAdmin
+  .from('price_ledger')
+  .update({ price: 150 })
+  .eq('id', 'ledger-uuid');
+// Bu hem trigger'i bypass eder (calismaz) hem de compliance ihlalidir!
+```
+
+✅ **DOĞRU: Normal client ile INSERT yapmak**
+```typescript
+const { error } = await supabase
+  .from('price_ledger')
+  .insert({
+    product_id: productId,
+    price: 150.00,
+    effective_from: new Date().toISOString(),
+    change_reason: 'Fiyat güncellemesi',
+    previous_price: currentPrice
+  });
+```
+
+**Onemli Hatirlatmalar:**
+
+1. **Asla price_ledger'da UPDATE/DELETE yapmayin** - Trigger engeller, uygulama hata verir
+2. **Fiyat hatasi yapildiginda** - Yeni kayit ekleyin, change_reason'da aciklayin
+3. **Guncel fiyat gerektiginde** - `current_prices` VIEW kullanin, price_ledger'dan MAX(effective_from) sorgusu YAPMAYIn (performans sorunu)
+4. **Trigger'i disable etmeyin** - Compliance ihlalidir, yasal sorun yaratir
+5. **Service role ile bypass etmeyin** - Audit trail bozulur, kim degistirdi bilinemez

+### 003: Package Management
+
+`003_package_management.sql` migrasyonu, ozaMenu platformunun dinamik paket yonetim sistemini olusturan dort kritik tablo icerir. Bu sistem, **hard-coded limit kullanmadan**, tum paket ozelliklerini veritabanindan yoneterek esneklik ve olceklenebilirlik saglar. Isletmelerin abonelik paketleri, ozellik erisim haklari ve ozel izinler bu tablolar uzerinden kontrol edilir.
+
+#### features
+
+**Platform ozelliklerinin katalogunu tutan tablo.** Her kayit, bir ozelligi (feature) temsil eder ve bu ozelligin hangi paketlerde bulundugunu belirler. Yeni ozellikler eklenmesi veya mevcut ozelliklerin guncellenmesi kod degisikligi gerektirmez.
+
+| Kolon | Tip | Constraint | Aciklama |
+|-------|-----|------------|----------|
+| `id` | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() | Ozelligin benzersiz kimlik numarasi |
+| `key` | VARCHAR(100) | UNIQUE, NOT NULL | Ozellik anahtari (ornek: "unlimited_products", "image_upload") |
+| `name` | VARCHAR(255) | NOT NULL | Insan okunabilir ozellik adi (ornek: "Sinirsiz Urun Ekleme") |
+| `description` | TEXT | | Ozellik aciklamasi |
+| `category` | VARCHAR(50) | | Ozellik kategorisi (ornek: "limits", "features", "support") |
+| `is_active` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Ozellik aktif mi? |
+| `created_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Olusturma zamani |
+| `metadata` | JSONB | DEFAULT '{}' | Ekstra ozellik bilgileri (icon, limits, vb.) |
+
+**Onemli Notlar:**
+- `key` kolonu unique'dir ve kod tarafinda ozellik kontrolunde kullanilir
+- `category` ozellikleri gruplamak icin kullanilir: "limits", "features", "branding", "support", "integrations"
+- `metadata` JSONB kolonu asagidaki gibi esnek veri saklar:
+  ```json
+  {
+    "icon": "📦",
+    "default_limit": 20,
+    "unit": "items",
+    "premium_limit": null
+  }
+  ```
+- Her ozellik bir veya daha fazla pakette (plan) bulunabilir
+
+**Ozellik Kategorileri:**
+
+| Kategori | Aciklama | Ornekler |
+|----------|----------|----------|
+| `limits` | Sayi sinirlamalari | max_categories, max_products, max_price_changes |
+| `features` | On/off ozellikler | image_upload, logo_usage, multi_language |
+| `branding` | Gorsel ozellikler | custom_colors, background_image, custom_fonts |
+| `support` | Destek seviyeleri | priority_support, whatsapp_support, phone_support |
+| `integrations` | Entegrasyonlar | google_my_business, social_media_share, analytics |
+
+**Ornek Kayitlar:**
+```sql

+);
+
+-- Coklu dil destegi

+  'multi_language',

+#### plans
+
+**Abonelik paketlerini tanimleyan tablo.** Lite, Professional ve Premium gibi paketlerin ozellikleri, fiyatlari ve sinirlamalarini icerir. Her paket, `features` tablosundaki belirli ozellikleri iceren bir koleksiyondur.
+
+| Kolon | Tip | Constraint | Aciklama |
+|-------|-----|------------|----------|
+| `id` | UUID | PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() | Paketin benzersiz kimlik numarasi |
+| `name` | VARCHAR(100) | UNIQUE, NOT NULL | Paket adi (ornek: "lite", "professional", "premium") |
+| `display_name` | VARCHAR(255) | NOT NULL | Gosterim adi (ornek: "Professional Plan") |
+| `description` | TEXT | | Paket aciklamasi |
+| `price_monthly` | DECIMAL(10,2) | NOT NULL | Aylik ucret (TL cinsinden) |
+| `price_yearly` | DECIMAL(10,2) | | Yillik ucret (indirimli) |
+| `is_active` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL, DEFAULT true | Paket aktif mi? |
+| `display_order` | INTEGER | NOT NULL, DEFAULT 0 | Fiyatlandirma sayfasinda gosterim sirasi |
+| `features` | JSONB | NOT NULL, DEFAULT '[]' | Bu pakete dahil ozellik key'leri |
+| `limits` | JSONB | DEFAULT '{}' | Paket sinirlamalari (kategori, urun sayisi vb.) |
+| `metadata` | JSONB | DEFAULT '{}' | Ekstra paket bilgileri (renk, highlight, vb.) |
+| `created_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Olusturma zamani |
+| `updated_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL, DEFAULT NOW() | Guncelleme zamani |
+
+**Onemli Notlar:**
+- `name` kolonu sistem tarafinda kullanilir (ornek: "lite", "professional", "premium")
+- `features` JSONB kolonu, `features.key` degerlerinin dizisini icerir
+- `limits` JSONB kolonu, sayi sinirlamalarini saklar:
+  ```json
+  {
+    "max_categories": 3,
+    "max_products": 20,
+    "max_price_changes": 2,
+    "max_tables": 10,
+    "max_languages": 1
+  }

+  }

+- `price_yearly` genellikle `price_monthly * 10` veya `price_monthly * 11` olur (yillik indirim)
